title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 17
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．１７
overview:
Flash Sega Saturn Vol. 17 is a Japanese promotional disc from Sega's Flash Sega Saturn series, offering playable trial versions and video footage of Saturn games. Menus are in Japanese.

The Sonic Jam demo lets you play the first three acts of Sonic the Hedgehog and two acts of Sonic the Hedgehog 2, and run around Sonic World for 60 seconds.

Playable demos:
- Choujikuu Yousai Macross
- Harukaze Sentai V-Force
- Magical Drop III
- Salamander Deluxe Pack Plus
- Sonic Jam

Videos include Full Cowl Mini Yonku Super Factory and Marica: Shinjitsu no Sekai.
